notes: A self-contained, mobile-first concept site for Good Ground Clearance Co., a fictional Johannesburg home-clearance service. The enquiry flow validates and saves a brief in-browser, with copy/download recovery; it does not transmit enquiries to a live inbox. First-view budget: 80 KiB; shipped HTML plus the local hero SVG is 76.6 KiB, with no third-party requests. Headless Chromium in-memory checks passed at 320, 390 and 1440 px; navigation, keyboard entry, validation, clipboard/download, the storage path (test shim), storage-denied recovery and success/edit states passed without console or page errors. Scroll reveals were checked. This environment blocked direct file:// and localhost navigation by browser policy, so cold-open and native-origin persistence were not browser-verified; the relative asset path and static source were code-checked.
